about: Inkling 2 Mini (26B looped MoE, ~3B active, vision, thinking) UD-Q4_K_XL with the F16 vision projector and the DSpark Q8_0 draft model (--spec-type draft-dspark, 3 drafted tokens) on one 24 GB card, everything on the GPU. llama.cpp from Unsloth's prebuilt b12572-mix-8eebad4 (unslothai/llama.cpp a5ba2dd, CUDA 13 portable): the Inkling 2 architecture and DSpark are not in a ggml-org release yet. The full 131,072-token window fits only at -ub 128: at the default ubatch the prompt compute buffer (6.4 GiB) does not fit beside the weights, draft and projector, and q4_0 KV does not help because the compute buffer, not the KV cache, is the limit. q8_0 KV, flash attention, one slot, Thinking Machines' recommended sampling. CUDA graphs are off (GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1): with them on, instantiating the graph for the second request runs out of memory at 131,072 tokens. That costs decode speed; drop to 65,536 tokens if you want graphs back. Measured on one RTX 3090 24GB: 24.0 GB VRAM.
setup: Not Docker; Linux x86-64 with an NVIDIA driver for CUDA 13 (the archive bundles the CUDA 13.3 runtime). Unpack the archive into llama-b12572-mix-8eebad4/ next to models/ and run from that directory. Keep the card otherwise empty: at 131,072 tokens the launch takes 24.0 of 24.5 GB.
